import { setTimeout } from "node:timers/promises";

const ZERO = 0;
const RETRY_MS = 200;

export async function waitForRetry(delay: number, signal?: AbortSignal) {
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout();
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(0);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(undefined);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(undefined, 0, { signal });
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(ZERO);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(16);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(10, "value");
  await setTimeout(17);
  await setTimeout(200);
  await setTimeout(RETRY_MS);
  await setTimeout(delay);
  await setTimeout(200, "value");
  await setTimeout(200, 0);
}
